summary: A digital input is left without a defined logic level after its pull resistor is removed, so it floats. The rule engine confirms 8 finding(s).

confirmed_findings.title: Regulator missing input capacitor
confirmed_findings.detail: Regulator U2 (AMS1117-3.3) has no capacitor on its input net '+5V'. Most regulators oscillate or overshoot without it.
evidence: no capacitor attached to input net

confirmed_findings.title: Floating digital input
confirmed_findings.detail: Net 'RESET' connects only input pins (U1.1) with nothing driving or biasing it — these inputs float.
evidence: input pin with no driver on net

confirmed_findings.title: IC without decoupling capacitor
confirmed_findings.detail: IC U2 (AMS1117-3.3) has supply pins without any decoupling capacitor to ground: pin 3 (+5V)
evidence: supply pin on '+5V' with no cap-to-ground on that rail

confirmed_findings.title: Net with only one connected pin
confirmed_findings.detail: Net '+5V' connects only U2.3. Check for a typo in a label or a missing wire.

confirmed_findings.title: Net with only one connected pin
confirmed_findings.detail: Net 'RESET' connects only U1.1. Check for a typo in a label or a missing wire.

confirmed_findings.title: Control pin without defined idle level
confirmed_findings.detail: Net 'RESET' looks like an IC control line (reset/enable/chip-select) with no pull resistor setting its idle state.
evidence: matched by name/pin-name heuristic (reset); no resistor to a rail found on this net

recommendations.title: Fix for COMP-011
recommendations.detail: Add the datasheet-recommended input capacitor close to the pin (commonly 1–10 µF plus 100 nF; check the specific regulator's requirements).

recommendations.title: Fix for CONN-004
recommendations.detail: Drive the net from a source or tie it high/low through a resistor.
